input_role: Each reference/NN_beard_close.png is an enlarged approved source crop; output is transparent facial-hair support for source matting during import

records.name: 八字短髭
records.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit.
The attached image is a nearest-neighbour enlarged crop of a USER-APPROVED Chinese game portrait. Extract ONLY the existing facial-hair pigment, preserving this exact design, stroke direction, density, relative shape and arrangement. This is a production modular beard support, not a new beard design.
Output one genuine transparent RGBA PNG. Keep the input crop's proportions and the same relative arrangement; do not rotate, mirror, distort, thicken, shorten or change the hairstyle. Preserve individual tapered charcoal-brown/gray-black matte ink hairs and fine feathered tips. Strong main strokes should have firm opaque cores with natural antialiased translucent edges; do not wash out all the hairs.
REMOVE all skin/beige haze, nose, lips, lip shadow, neck, clothing, scalp hair and paper to alpha0. Empty spaces between beard regions and hair strands must be transparent. No rectangular skin patch, broad skin shadow, pale cutout halo, gray painted background or painted checkerboard. Nothing except the specified facial hair. No text or labels.
Match the project's delicate soft gongbi/ink-wash painting, no photo pores, black solid masks, vector moustache, metallic shine or extra coarse hair. Keep it recognizably the same beard as the input crop.
Extract ONLY the narrow, naturally parted upper-lip moustache, including the fine diagonal outward/downward tips at the two mouth corners. Entire chin/jaw/under-lip area is hairless and must stay empty transparency. Do NOT include the mouth/lips below the moustache or draw any new chin beard. Keep both moustache halves and their natural central division exactly.
